material_systems.name: DTM Primer for Steel Garage Door Repaint

primer.type: Acrylic DTM (Direct-to-Metal) Primer with Rust-Inhibitive Pigments
products: Sherwin-Williams Pro Industrial DTM Acrylic Primer
PPG Pitt-Tech Plus DTM Industrial Primer
primer.notes: Spot prime on sound paint (bare/thin areas only). Full prime on failing paint or after rust debridement. Rust-inhibitive — prevents flash rust on bare steel. Unlike NC, RP sound-paint steel does NOT require full DTM prime — existing paint film has sealed wax contamination.

material_systems.notes: Primary primer for all steel garage door repaint states. Spot or full scope driven by substrate_state. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT = spot bare areas. SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT = spot or full depending on bare area percentage. SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST = full prime on debrided areas.

material_systems.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Garage Doors

products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec EXT Primer
primer.notes: FULL COVERAGE mandatory — cannot spot prime over chalk. Penetrates degraded chalk layer to bond with sound substrate beneath. Applied after chalk remediation wash.

material_systems.notes: Chalk-binding primer for all substrates showing chalking. Full coverage mandatory. Common on south/west-facing garage doors with extended sun exposure.

material_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Exterior Primer for Wood Garage Door Repaint

products: Benjamin Moore Fresh Start Multi-Purpose Primer
primer.notes: For wood garage doors with sound or failing paint showing bare areas. Spot or full prime. Non-tannin species.

material_systems.notes: Standard acrylic primer for wood bare areas. For tannin-rich species (cedar, redwood), use SYS_EXT_GDRP_PRIMER_ALKYD_STAINBLOCK instead.

material_systems.name: Alkyd Stain-Blocking Primer for Tannin-Rich Wood Repaint

primer.notes: Required for cedar, redwood, fir garage doors showing tannin bleed through existing coating. Deep penetration, superior tannin blocking.

material_systems.notes: Conditional on tannin bleed visible during assessment. May be spot-applied at knot locations or full-surface for severe bleed.

material_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Delaminated Composite Overlays

primer.notes: For carriage-style composite overlays with adhesion failure, delamination, or exposed slick substrate. Grips slick composite while providing tooth for topcoat.

material_systems.notes: Conditional — needed when composite overlays have adhesion failure or slick surface exposed during prep.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Latex for Garage Door Repaint

finish.notes: Mid-grade 100% acrylic exterior latex. 2 coats with leapfrog technique on sectional doors. Works on all three substrate types. Satin or semi-gloss.

material_systems.notes: Standard finish for QT3 repaint. LRV restriction: composite overlays LRV > 55 (HARD STOP). Steel LRV > 30 recommended.

material_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Latex for Garage Door Repaint

finish.notes: Premium 100% acrylic with superior UV resistance, self-cleaning technology, enhanced color retention. 2 coats with intercoat sand (220-grit) and leapfrog technique.

material_systems.notes: Premium finish for QT4 repaint with intercoat sanding.

coverage_profiles.notes: DTM primer on steel garage door surface. Smooth factory steel = higher end of range. Weathered/pitted = lower end.
Chalk-binding primer — lower coverage due to chalking surface absorption.
Acrylic primer on wood garage door. Higher coverage than DTM due to smoother prepared surface.
Finish coat on primed garage door. 2 coats required. Spray at 50-70% transfer efficiency — budget 25-33% more material.

consumables.name: 150-Grit Sandpaper
consumables.notes: For degloss scuff-sanding steel and adhesion prep. Reusable across specs.

consumables.name: 220-Grit Sandpaper
consumables.notes: For intercoat sanding (QT4). Reusable across specs.

consumables.name: 80-Grit Sandpaper (Rust/Heavy Prep)
consumables.notes: Coarse grit for aggressive rust removal on steel. 1 sheet per door for rust debridement.

consumables.name: Tack Cloth
consumables.notes: For dust removal after sanding and between coats. Reusable across specs.

consumables.name: Blue Painter's Tape (1.5 inch)
consumables.notes: For weatherstrip protection, window masking edges, trim line masking. 60-yard roll. Reusable across specs.

consumables.name: Pre-Taped Masking Film (24 inch)
consumables.notes: For siding masking during spray. Reusable across specs.

consumables.name: Canvas Drop Cloth (4x15 ft)
consumables.notes: Driveway/apron protection. Canvas ONLY — NOT poly sheeting (safety hazard). Reusable across specs.

consumables.name: Canvas Driveway Runner / Absorbent Mat
consumables.notes: Supplemental driveway protection for direct spray zone. 1 per door.

consumables.name: HDPE Static-Cling Film (window masking)
consumables.notes: For garage door window insert masking. Static-cling eliminates adhesive residue. Conditional on windows present.

consumables.name: Angled Sash Brush (2.5 inch)
consumables.notes: For brush application and panel recess detail. Reusable across specs.

consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 310
consumables.notes: 310 or 412 tip for metal garage door faces. 0.010-0.014 inch orifice. 100-mesh blue filter for enamel.

consumables.name: Biodegradable Degreaser/TSP
consumables.notes: For cleaning existing coating before prep. TSP for wood, solvent-based degreaser for steel.

consumables.name: Rigid Scraper (3 inch)
consumables.notes: For scraping failing/peeling paint. Durable carbide or steel blade.

consumables.name: Exterior Paintable Caulk (Polyurethane)
consumables.notes: For panel joint repair and seal refresh. Exterior-grade paintable polyurethane.

consumables.name: Exterior Wood Filler
consumables.notes: For filling cracks, nail holes, and minor damage on wood garage doors. Conditional on wood substrate.

compatibility_rules.description: Steel substrate with SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST requires DTM primer on all bare/debrided areas
SS_EXT_CHALKING requires chalk-binding primer — standard acrylic or DTM will NOT adhere to chalk residue
Composite/carriage overlays with LRV < 55 require solar-reflective coating — standard dark colors cause thermal distortion
Steel with LRV < 30 — IR-reflective coating recommended to prevent thermal warping
Roller application PROHIBITED on metal garage doors — introduces orange peel texture
compatibility_rules.constraint: HARD STOP — spray or brush only

compatibility_rules.description: SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is steel-only — wood and composite cannot have this state
